Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: ONE premium full-bleed horizontal 16:9 TV wallpaper, ideally 3840x2160. Strong composition constraint: ALL interesting furniture, equipment and props are in the TOP 60% and side edges. The entire BOTTOM 40% must be very calm continuous floor/rug with low texture contrast, no objects, no table legs in bottom center, no bright reflections or hard shadow stripes; this area will sit behind a large app carousel. Pull the camera back / widen framing to achieve this deliberately. Top 10% also quiet enough for clock/navigation. Do NOT draw interface, icons, menu bars, lettering, watermarks or people. Warm believable cinematic photography, beautiful wood and tactile fabric, no marble, no pale stone pedestals, no visual clutter. No recognizable film/game images or legible text. TV/monitor screens dark and blank except arcade screens with subtle nonspecific pixel glow. Wintry atmosphere should be evident in a window or entrance high in frame, not through Christmas decorations.
A cozy HOME CINEMA LIVING ROOM in WINTER DAY. Rear-wall walnut media console with blank dark television, a linen sofa and thick wool blanket at far left in upper-middle frame, a small bowl of popcorn and ceramic mug ON the rear side table, warm shaded lamps, cream plaster and honey wood. A high side window shows softly snow-covered trees, winter daylight. Bottom 40% broad plain oatmeal wool rug, uncluttered, no coffee table occupying the carousel area. Intimate warm amber/cream/cinnamon palette, room furniture purposefully pulled back into top 60%.
